digest_rule: Sort by cache_path; SHA256 UTF8(cache_path+TAB+jpeg_sha256+LF for each entry). SHA values aggregated from completed per-frame readback verification; no extra source-video scans.
cache_layout: 149 video directories referenced at metadata-v3/frames; v4_11 referenced at metadata-v4/frames; follow frames-required.csv cache_path

dense_input_references.rule: same hash may be reused remotely; no local source-video copies made

preprocessing.runtime: JPEG decode BGR to RGB then INTER_LINEAR resize112
